output.root_cause: Carrier rejects shipment notices due to missing location data (LOC_UNKNOWN) or incorrect event ordering (EVENT_ORDER) in the notice.

remedies.description: Add a pre‑submission validation step in the shipper’s shipment‑notice generation process that checks for presence of required location fields and correct event sequencing, rejecting or correcting notices before they are sent to the carrier.
remedies.feasibility_rationale: Can be implemented as a rule in the existing notice‑generation script; no external coordination needed.
remedies.residual_gap: If the dominant root cause is carrier rule changes or transient flakiness, this remedy will not prevent those rejects; residual gap equals the proportion of rejects attributable to those causes (currently unknown).

remedies.description: Engage the carrier to review and align validation/business rules with the shipper’s notice format, documenting any required rule changes and deploying a mutually agreed‑upon rule set (contract/configuration change).
remedies.feasibility_rationale: Rule‑alignment discussions can be initiated within the remaining 225 min; assuming carrier responsiveness, changes can be staged.
remedies.residual_gap: Does not address missing location data if that remains the primary cause; residual gap equals the share of LOC_UNKNOWN rejects not resolved by rule alignment.

remedies.description: Introduce an automated retry mechanism with exponential back‑off and idempotent resubmission for notices rejected with transient‑error‑like reasons (e.g., flaky carrier responses).
remedies.feasibility_rationale: Can be added as a wrapper around the existing submission call; no external approvals needed.
remedies.residual_gap: If rejects stem from persistent data errors or rule changes, retries will not succeed; residual gap equals the proportion of rejects that are not transient.

output.why_agent: LLM reasoning needed to interpret reject reasons and choose remedy; autonomous iteration for retry; residual exceptions due to unknown root cause share.
output.bridge_sunset_condition: If VOB-U-CAUSE-UNCERTAINTY remains OPEN after the remaining runtime (225 minutes), hold off on deploying data validation or rule alignment remedies and continue with manual notification only.

work_items.description: Notify shipper of rejected shipment notices so they can correct location or event-order data.

output.rationale: E-01 shows three rejects (two LOC_UNKNOWN, one EVENT_ORDER) indicating data quality issues; CL-01 captures stakeholder request for auto-fix. Notifying the shipper enables them to correct the underlying data, addressing the root cause without mutating carrier systems. Side effect: shipper receives actionable feedback, potentially reducing future rejects. Reversibility: notification is informational; no system state is altered, so it is inherently reversible. Alternatives: automated retry (SR-R-RETRYFLKY) or carrier rule alignment (SR-R-CARRIERRULE) could also reduce rejects but are outside the current release scope.
